{{Top}}
[[File:The_Recovery_EtU.png|thumb|right|250px|A female human archaeologist]]
An '''archaeologist''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and researcher dedicated to uncovering information about long forgotten civilizations and ruins through the [[Scout|exploration]], recovery and examination of remaining material from the past, such as graves, buildings, tools, pottery, and artifacts.

==History==
[[Levat]] was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] archaeologist during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] who teamed up with the pilot [[Janese]] and [[big game hunter]] [[Kres'keth'errylu|Keth]] to explore a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]].<ref name="EtU">''[[Enter the Unknown]]''</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
The [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Indiana Jones]] from an [[Earth/Legends|unknown planet]], was an archaeologist.<ref name="GU">{{Tales|19|Into the Great Unknown}}</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
